response.sql: WITH pair_counts AS (SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS behaviour_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY tr.transreg, t.tradekind), pair_shares AS (SELECT tradekind, behaviour_count, behaviour_count::numeric / SUM(behaviour_count) OVER () AS share FROM pair_counts) SELECT tradekind, AVG(behaviour_count) AS average_count_per_pair, AVG(share) AS average_share_per_pair FROM pair_shares GROUP BY tradekind ORDER BY tradekind;
